premises.text: The vision system finds berries and determines ripeness with human-equivalent accuracy
premises.evidence_span: Built on a robust dataset, Traptics Robot can find berries and determine ripeness with equivalent accuracy as people.

premises.text: A patented gripper with soft food-safe silicone belts and mechanical compliance extracts berries delicately across sizes and shapes
premises.evidence_span: our patented gripper delicately extracts the produce from the plant

premises.text: The system runs in real time on a tractor in real fields and is robust to dust, rain, wind, and vibration
premises.evidence_span: It is robust to dust, dirt, rain, wind, vibrations, and the other aspects of the tough farm environment.

premises.text: All computation is local, with no internet or off-site compute required
premises.evidence_span: it does all this locally. No internet, no off-site compute.

premises.text: Year-round strawberry harvest is a better target than low-value weeding or seasonal apple harvesting
premises.evidence_span: Traptic focuses on year-round strawberry harvest.

premises.text: No change in the growing process is required, giving a smooth deployment path
premises.evidence_span: We don't require any change in growing process, providing a smooth path for deployment.

premises.text: Robots-as-a-service at 23 cents per pound undercuts current picking spend, with machine, tractor, and driver included
premises.evidence_span: We pick strawberries, and growers will pay us 23 cents per pound. This is slightly less than the current spend.

value.text: Automated strawberry picking that saves the world's food production system by doing the work people do not want to do
value.evidence_span: Our robots are saving the world's food production system by automating the work people don't want to do.

causal_links.evidence_span: Then it plans a path to grab it, and our software commands the robot arm to move the gripper to the berry.
Our system does all this in real time while hanging off the back of a tractor and moving continuously over real strawberry fields.
We don't require any change in growing process, providing a smooth path for deployment.
growers will pay us 23 cents per pound
